'''Brayso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Agent]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he monitored the communications of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
